global: This ramen features a rich amber, glossy miso broth with bubbles and submerged noodles. A pink, spiral-shaped Naruto fish cake rests in a white ceramic bowl with blue and green swirls, set on a wooden table with warm brown grain.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue and green swirling pattern, smooth surface, slightly raised rim with decorative border.
regions.soup: The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and textured with visible bubbles and submerged noodles.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pink, spiral-shaped, with textured surface and visible white strands.
